{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if there are any refunded orders in this group
num_refunded_in_loyal = (loyal_completed['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Number of refunded orders in LOYAL group:", num_refunded_in_loyal)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Check if LOYAL segment exists
print("Unique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())"}
